segments.sn15.10:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
segments.sn15.10:2.1: “Anamataggoyaṃ, bhikkhave, saṃsāro … pe … ekapuggalassa, bhikkhave, kappaṃ sandhāvato saṃsarato siyā evaṃ mahā aṭṭhikaṅkalo aṭṭhipuñjo aṭṭhirāsi yathāyaṃ vepullo pabbato, sace saṃhārako assa, sambhatañca na vinasseyya.
segments.sn15.10:2.4: Anamataggoyaṃ, bhikkhave, saṃsāro … pe … alaṃ vimuccitun”ti.
segments.sn15.10:3.2: Idaṃ vatvāna sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā –
segments.sn15.10:4.3: Siyā pabbatasamo rāsi, iti vuttaṃ mahesinā.
segments.sn15.10:5.1: “So kho panāyaṃ akkhāto, vepullo pabbato mahā;
segments.sn15.10:8.3: Sāsapā sāvakā gaṅgā, daṇḍo ca puggalena cāti.

lines: Imesaṃ pana sattānaṃ saaṭṭhikālato anaṭṭhikālova bahutaro.
Gaṇḍuppādakādipāṇabhūtānañhi etesaṃ aṭṭhimeva natthi, macchakacchapādibhūtānaṃ pana aṭṭhimeva bahutaraṃ, tasmā anaṭṭhikālañca bahuaṭṭhikālañca aggahetvā samaṭṭhikālova gahetabbo.
Magadhānaṃ giribbajeti magadharaṭṭhassa giribbaje, giriparikkhepe ṭhitoti attho.
